packageRules.description: blueimp-md5 is vendored into the extension and needs a manual `make vendor`
prBodyNotes: This package is vendored: run `make vendor` on this branch and commit `extension/vendor/md5.js`. CI fails until the vendored copy matches.

packageRules.description: The iPhone Shortcut must be rebuilt with the new Cherri version
prBodyNotes: Rebuild the iPhone Shortcut on a Mac: run `make shortcuts` on this branch and commit `ios/Später.shortcut` and `ios/shortcuts.lock`. CI fails until that is done.
